notes:
### Timeline Repair & Blackscreen

- Timeline-corruption recovery now opens the existing opaque black curtain before stopping the player and closes it after verified video readiness or a logged recovery timeout. This covers the previously exposed Kodi skin during timeline repair.
- Carry the timeline repair limit and per-test internal restart counters across player sessions to reduce immediate duplicate recovery cycles.

### Two-Hour Prompt Reliability

- The Stop at 2 h / Unlimited popup now uses a modal Kodi dialog with two side-by-side buttons, handling focused Select/Enter and button-click events.
- The decision window is extended to 30 seconds and still opens at T-2:30; playback continues while the dialog is displayed.
- Explicit Stop saves the log at the scheduled two-hour endpoint; Unlimited removes the timer without restarting playback. No selection still saves the log and triggers Shutdown at the original endpoint.

### Manual Stop & Session Logs

- Manual Player Stop during a timed or Unlimited One Channel check now saves the log only; Shutdown and Suspend are explicitly suppressed for manual stops.
- Log snapshots use one filename per Kodi/LibreELEC session and overwrite an earlier snapshot from that same session. A new Kodi session gets a new filename; the previous snapshot is preserved if saving fails.

### Recovery Diagnostics

- Added correlated restart counters, curtain-owner/state diagnostics and more detailed recovery and timeout logging for unattended tests.
- The normal Dorcel five-minute SOURCE_WINDOW behavior, signed-session expiry timing, standby thresholds, live delay and PVR_COM / PVR_COM_SITE routing remain unchanged. Frozen-frame capture is not enabled.

### Important

- The improved timeline curtain, two-hour modal dialog and Unlimited/manual-stop behavior require real LibreELEC testing; offline code checks cannot verify the HDMI picture or real remote input.
- A direct One Channel Unlimited run avoids the two-hour end prompt and scheduled shutdown. It runs until manually stopped or interrupted by an external event.
